title: The Day Pebble Stopped Making Watches and Sold What It Could
conflicts: 2015-16 fundraising: TechCrunch says $28m in debt and venture money over eight months, The Next Web more than $26m; no figure used. Sale price undisclosed; only Bloomberg's 'less than $40 million' (via Digital Trends) is given, marked as reported. Refund timing differs between reports; omitted.
notes: Causes of the closure are stated only as Migicovsky himself put them in his own posts. Quote stance 'challenges' (Epictetus on reproaching neither others nor oneself, set against Migicovsky's self-blame). Pebble's original blog post is only in the Internet Archive, which the fetch tool cannot open, so its wording is paraphrased from MacRumors.
